page.overview:
Who is Archaeological team?

The archaeological team is a group that retrieved the Millennium Puzzle from the Valley of the Kings, in the Toei Yu-Gi-Oh! anime.

They are based on the unseen archaeological team from the manga.

The team of three entered a pharaoh's tomb, relieved to find that plunderers had not yet raided it. They spotted the box containing the Millennium Puzzle and wondered if it was the Games of Darkness. As the leader went to pick it up, he started to feel discomfort and dropped to his knees. As his team members came to his aid, he then dropped to the ground and said that the box contained the puzzle of darkness.

Sugoroku Mutou claimed that the each member of the team died a mysterious death, with the last one uttering "Game of Darkness".
